notes: Mardin Airport is 20 minutes from the city. A car is useless in Old Mardin, so walk. For Midyat, Dara and Nusaybin, use a car or minibus.
Order the stuffed ribs (kaburga dolması) in advance at Cercis Murat. Mırra is a bitter coffee, and the cup is handed back. Almond candy and terebinth soap make good souvenirs.
Summer temperatures top 40°C: sightsee from 08:30 to 12:00 and after 17:00, rest in mansion courtyards at midday, and carry 3 litres of water.
Respect service times at Syriac churches and monasteries. Deyrulzafaran is by guided tour only, and short sleeves are not allowed.
The streets of Old Mardin are steep and paved with stone; wear comfortable shoes and cool off in the abbaras.
Sunset at Kasimiye is Mardin's most famous moment; arrive 1 hour early.

stops.name: Zinciriye Medresesi
stops.tips: Mardin's highest madrasa; from the domed terrace you look over the Mesopotamian plain. Cool in the morning.

stops.name: Mardin Grand Mosque
stops.tips: Artuqid minaret in the middle of the bazaar.

stops.name: Mardin Coppersmiths' Bazaar
stops.tips: Copper, almond candy and Mardin soap; donkeys still carry goods along the stone lanes.

stops.name: Cercis Murat Konağı
stops.tips: Syriac-Mardin cuisine in a stone mansion; order the stuffed ribs (kaburga dolması) in advance. Terrace views.

stops.name: Kasimiye Madrasa
stops.tips: Twin-domed madrasa with a courtyard pool; the plain turns red at sunset.

backups.name: Seyr-i Merdin Kafe
backups.tips: Terrace café for coffee and Mardin pastry (Mardin çöreği).

backups.name: Mardin Museum
backups.tips: Archaeology museum in the former patriarchate; an indoor option instead of the madrasa.

stops.name: Deyrulzafaran Monastery
stops.tips: 1,500-year-old Syriac monastery; guided tour covers the sun temple and patriarch tombs. Take the first group in the morning.

stops.name: Kırklar Church
stops.tips: Active Syriac church in Old Mardin; quiet courtyard.

stops.name: Antik Mardin Sofrası
stops.tips: Ikbebet, sembusek and dobo in a mansion restaurant.

stops.name: Şahkulubey Mansion
stops.tips: Stone mansion and courtyard; walk on through the bazaar lanes.

stops.name: Mardin Castle Viewpoint
stops.tips: The castle is military, but the viewpoint at its foot is open; city and plain at sunset.

backups.name: Mardin Kebapçısı Yusuf Usta
backups.tips: Mardin kebab and içli köfte (stuffed bulgur meatballs).

stops.name: Dara Ancient City
stops.tips: 30 km from Mardin; Roman cistern, necropolis and rock tombs, known as the "Ephesus of Mesopotamia".

stops.name: Dara Village Breakfast
stops.tips: Mardin breakfast in a village house; crumbled cheese and bulgur with eggs.

stops.name: Savur
stops.tips: Stone town nicknamed Little Mardin; castle, mansions and mulberry orchards.

stops.name: Savur Kahveci Konağı
stops.tips: Mırra (bitter coffee) and mulberry molasses in a mansion.

backups.name: Kızıltepe Grand Mosque
backups.tips: Artuqid mosque; an alternative to Savur.

stops.name: Midyat Konukevi
stops.tips: The mansion from the TV series Sıla; terrace and stonework. Midyat is 1 hour away.

stops.name: Midyat Old Bazaar
stops.tips: Telkari (silver filigree) masters and Syriac wine.

stops.name: Mor Barsavmo Church
stops.tips: Midyat's active Syriac church.

stops.name: Midyat Kasr-ı Nehroz Restaurant
stops.tips: Syriac cuisine in a stone mansion; try perde pilavı (pastry-wrapped rice) and alluciye.

stops.name: Mor Gabriel Monastery
stops.tips: One of the world's oldest active monasteries (397); guided tour, mosaics. 20 km from Midyat.

backups.name: Hasankeyf
backups.tips: New Hasankeyf and the castle; an alternative to Mor Gabriel (1 hour).

stops.name: Mor Yakup Church Nusaybin
stops.tips: 4th-century church and the excavation of the School of Nisibis; on the Syrian border.

stops.name: Nusaybin Zeynel Abidin Mosque
stops.tips: Tomb and mosque, next to the church.

stops.name: Nusaybin Çarşı Lokantası
stops.tips: Town eatery serving ribs and pilaf.

stops.name: Girnavaz Mound
stops.tips: Assyrian mound near Nusaybin; excavation site.

backups.name: Mardin Dara Road Viewpoint
backups.tips: Views over the plain; an alternative to the mound.

stops.name: Mardin Soap Workshop
stops.tips: See how terebinth (bıttım) soap is made, and shop.

stops.name: Mardin Protestant Church
stops.tips: Restored church, now a cultural centre.

stops.name: Mardin Abbaras
stops.tips: Vaulted lanes running beneath houses; cool passages.

stops.name: Mardin Leyli Kahvaltı
stops.tips: Mardin breakfast with clotted cream and honey, plus sembusek.

stops.name: Şehidiye Madrasa
stops.tips: Madrasa with a minaret and a tea garden; sunset.

backups.name: Latifiye Mosque
backups.tips: Artuqid mosque; an alternative to Şehidiye.

stops.name: Mardin Badem Şekercisi
stops.tips: Almond candy, Mardin soap and telkari souvenirs.

stops.name: Mardin 1. Cadde
stops.tips: Old Mardin's main street; one last walk.

stops.name: Mardin Kahvaltı Konağı
stops.tips: Farewell breakfast; terrace.

backups.name: Mardin Maristan Kafe
backups.tips: Café in an old Artuqid hospital; mırra and a terrace.
